label: Composition of selected grounding edges that start at an actual CONCRETE_6 root
definition: At the selected world w, if r is an actual concrete root and x is actual concrete, then the selected actual concrete grounding edges r to y and y to x give the selected actual concrete grounding edge r to x. The first edge supplies actual concreteness of r and the second supplies actual concreteness of y.
note: Analyst structural condition. It represents root-mediated composition as a direct edge of the supplied grounding relation, rather than merely finite reachability. A directed chain r to y to x without a selected edge from r to x violates it when r is a root and all three are actual concreta. In a graph with all such shortcut edges the condition holds. Whether the selected real grounding or productive relation has this closure remains open. Full transitivity of the actual-concrete graph suffices, and the condition imposes no composition law on pairs whose source is not a root.
